title: fix: include low-volume model stats
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Raises the public model-stats fetch limit from 200 to 5,000.
- Keeps the existing three-success reliability threshold unchanged.
- Rotates the cache key so community image estimates refresh immediately after deployment.

Root cause: Enter truncated Tinybird results to the 200 highest-volume models, excluding every current community image model.

Checks: `npx biome check shared/utils/model-stats.ts`; `git diff --check`; live `limit=1000` query returned all 243 eligible models.

gist.headline: The long tail blooms
gist.blurb: The model garden was counting only its loudest flowers. Community image models are back in the public stats, with freshly grown estimates after deploy.
gist.summary: Raised the public Tinybird model-stats fetch limit from 200 to 5,000 and rotated its cache key, allowing all 243 eligible models—including community image models—to receive refreshed estimates while retaining the existing three-success threshold.
gist.impact: Users can now see community image-model estimates in public stats instead of only the 200 highest-volume models, with the updated data available immediately after deployment.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends a broad garden of small code-plants, where previously overlooked little image-model flowers now have visible stat tags alongside the large plants. A retro terminal shows a growing list of models, while a freshly turned cache-key sign suggests the garden has been refreshed.
